title: Rimini Street to Host Investor Day on January 14, 2027, in New York City
summary: The company will discuss how it's evolving its industry-leading support model, its vision & strategy for the emerging Agentic AI ERP market & more.
body_markdown:
## The Company will highlight its opportunities and unique solutions in enterprise software support and its ownership of the Agentic AI ERP market, present its sales strategy and financial model and host a panel discussion featuring Rimini Street global clients from a variety of industries


**LAS VEGAS, November 19, 2026 –**[Rimini Street, Inc.](https://www.riministreet.com/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=InvestorDay2027Announcement) , (Nasdaq: RMNI), a global provider of end-to-end enterprise software support, managed services and Agentic AI ERP innovation solutions, and the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software, today announced details for its upcoming Investor Day, to be held on January 14, 2027, in New York City.


**Investor Day Details**


**Date:** January 14, 2027
**Time:** 8:30 a.m. – 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time
**Location:** New York City


**In-Person Attendance:** Institutional investors and analysts interested in attending the Investor Day in person may contact Rimini Street Investor Relations[\[email protected\]](https://www.riministreet.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#1c554e5c6e75717572756f686e797968327f7371) for an event invitation and details. In-person space is limited and will be followed by a networking lunch with Rimini Street senior executives and client attendees.


**Webcast Registration:**[Register for the live webcast](https://app.webinar.net/nxJpdgY6v1X) or access the webcast through the Company’s[Investor Relations website](https://investors.riministreet.com/events) .


**Presentation Materials:** Materials will be available on the Company’s[Investor Relations website](https://investors.riministreet.com/events) on the day of the event.


**Replay:** A replay of the webcast will be available shortly following the event.


**Investor Day Agenda**


Join[CEO, Seth Ravin](https://www.riministreet.com/company/leadership/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=InvestorDay2027Announcement#seth-ravin) and his[Senior Executive Team](https://www.riministreet.com/company/leadership/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=InvestorDay2027Announcement) who will cover the following:


- **Strategic Vision and Market Opportunity**
An overview of Rimini Street’s strategy, competitive positioning and long-term growth opportunities.
- **Go-to-Market and Sales Strategy**
How Rimini Street is evolving its sales model to drive cross-sell and upsell, leverage partners and alliances, expand wallet share and acquire new clients.
- **Enterprise Software Support**
How Rimini Street is evolving and innovating its industry-leading support model and expanding availability across Oracle, SAP, VMware and more than 100 other enterprise software products.
- **Security Solutions**
How Rimini Street is helping clients protect and secure their enterprise software environments in a world of fast-evolving threats and how Rimini Street plans to use “Good AI” to protect clients from “Bad AI.”
- **Innovation Solutions**
Rimini Street’s vision and strategy for the emerging Agentic AI ERP market and how the Company is helping clients adopt and leverage Agentic AI to drive greater productivity and value from their enterprise IT. Rimini Street will share its end-to-end AI services that include dozens of pre-designed AI solutions that deploy simply over current enterprise software releases and Rimini Agentworks™, Rimini Govern™ for AI and Rimini Agentic UX™ solutions.
- **Financial Model and Long-Term Value Creation**
A review of Company revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, operating leverage and capital allocation priorities.
- **Global Client Panel**
Clients from around the world and from diverse industries will discuss their experience with Rimini Street and its solutions and discuss their visions and strategies with enterprise software, support, innovation and AI adoption.
- **Lunch and Executive Networking Q&A**
An open opportunity to network with attendees and spend time over lunch with Rimini Street’s senior leadership team and client attendees.
